run_test_wheel: run the test_wheel script to validate a built wheel in a fresh virtual environment using uv
run_find_latest_wheel: run find_latest_wheel to locate the most recently modified wheel file in the dist directory
test_wheel_import: test a wheel by installing it in a temporary venv and verifying the mhr module imports correctly
test_wheel_fresh_venv: test a wheel in an isolated virtual environment created with uv to ensure clean installation
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to find the latest wheel and test it in a fresh environment
